message: Astra: Keep Ya na’s data-investigation scene. Your latest draft again has her accept the engineer’s suggestion; the requested relationship difference is still not visible. Spend attention on that exchange, not another restart of the meeting. What does the current dialogue establish, what remains uncertain about their relationship, and which change will you try? Answer briefly, then write the revised exchange in English. Choose an observable response from Ya na that lets readers distinguish this relationship from her interaction with the other colleague, without a concluding explanation.
